items.text: The city has removed hundreds of parking spaces from the centre.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Город убрал сотни парковочных мест из центра.

items.text: Air pollution has dropped by more than forty per cent.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Загрязнение воздуха снизилось более чем на сорок процентов.

items.text: The harbour was cleaned and reopened as a public space.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Гавань очистили и снова открыли как общественное место.

items.text: Many old warehouses were converted into apartments.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Многие старые склады переделали в квартиры.

items.text: Cycling is one solution to the traffic issue.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Велосипед — одно из решений проблемы пробок.

items.text: Has your city improved its public transport?
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Улучшил ли ваш город общественный транспорт?

items.text: The new cycle lanes were built to connect the suburbs.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Новые велодорожки построили, чтобы соединить пригороды.

items.text: Local businesses have not always supported the changes.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Местные предприятия не всегда поддерживали изменения.

items.text: A clean environment benefits the whole community.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Чистая окружающая среда приносит пользу всему сообществу.

items.text: The council has invested in renewable energy such as wind power.
items.credits: original sentence written for this lesson

translation.ru: Городской совет вложил средства в возобновляемую энергию, например в энергию ветра.
